svg.aria-label: The TLS 1.1 encoding is the record, then the tag, then p+1 bytes each equal to p, padded to a multiple of the block size; for AES with HMAC-SHA-1 and a 5-byte record the admissible p are 6, 22, 38 up to 246
svg.text: Example: AES (b = 16), HMAC-SHA-1 (t = 20), a record of |R| = 5 bytes
